commands.name: get-environment-data
commands.docstring: Returns the deployment type and the enabled environment flags.

commands.name: get-enabled-flags
commands.docstring: Deprecated. Use `get-environment-data` instead.

commands.name: login-with-password
commands.docstring: Performs authentication using penpot password.

commands.name: logout
commands.docstring: Clears the authentication cookie and logout the current session.

commands.name: export-binfile
commands.docstring: Export a penpot file in a binary format.

commands.name: import-binfile
commands.docstring:
Import a penpot file in a binary format.

  The file content may be provided either as a multipart `file` upload
  or as an `upload-id` referencing a completed chunked-upload session,
  which allows importing files larger than the multipart size limit.

commands.name: get-profiles-for-file-comments
commands.docstring:
Retrieves a list of profiles with limited set of properties of all
  participants on comment threads of the file.

commands.name: create-demo-profile
commands.docstring:
A command that is responsible of creating a demo purpose
  profile. It only works if the `demo-users` flag is enabled in the
  configuration.

commands.name: create-share-link
commands.docstring:
Creates a share-link object.

  Share links are resources that allows external users access to specific
  pages of a file with specific permissions (who-comment and who-inspect).

commands.name: get-file-snapshot
commands.docstring:
Retrieve a file bundle with data from a specific snapshot for
  read-only preview. Does not modify any database state.

commands.name: get-file-object-thumbnails
commands.docstring: Retrieve a file object thumbnails.

commands.name: get-file-data-for-thumbnail
commands.docstring:
Retrieves the data for generate the thumbnail of the file. Used
  mainly for render thumbnails on dashboard.

commands.name: create-file-thumbnail
commands.docstring:
Creates or updates the file thumbnail. Mainly used for paint the
  grid thumbnails.

commands.name: get-file
commands.docstring: Retrieve a file by its ID. Only authenticated users.

commands.name: get-file-fragment
commands.docstring: Retrieve a file fragment by its ID. Only authenticated users.

commands.name: get-project-files
commands.docstring: Get all files for the specified project.

commands.name: has-file-libraries
commands.docstring: Checks if the file has libraries. Returns a boolean

commands.name: get-library-usage
commands.docstring: Gets the number of files that use the specified library.

commands.name: get-page
commands.docstring:
Retrieves the page data from file and returns it. If no page-id is
  specified, the first page will be returned. If object-id is
  specified, only that object and its children will be returned in the
  page objects data structure.

  If you specify the object-id, the page-id parameter becomes
  mandatory.

  Mainly used for rendering purposes on the exporter. It does not
  accepts client features.

commands.name: get-team-shared-files
commands.docstring: Get all file (libraries) for the specified team.

commands.name: get-file-summary
commands.docstring: Retrieve a file summary by its ID. Only authenticated users.

commands.name: get-file-stats
commands.docstring:
Return aggregate statistics for a single file: page count, shape
   counts by type, component/color/typography counts, and inbound and
   outbound library reference counts. Cheap alternative to `get-file`
   when only metrics are needed.

commands.name: get-file-libraries
commands.docstring: Get libraries used by the specified file.

commands.name: get-library-file-references
commands.docstring: Returns all the file references that use specified file (library) id.

commands.name: get-file-info
commands.docstring: Retrieve minimal file info by its ID.

commands.name: link-file-to-library
commands.docstring: Link a file to a library. Returns the recursive list of libraries used by that library

commands.name: update-file-library-sync-status
commands.docstring: Update the synchronization status of a file->library link

commands.name: ignore-file-library-sync-status
commands.docstring: Ignore updates in linked files

commands.name: permanently-delete-team-files
commands.docstring:
Mark the specified files to be deleted immediatelly on the
  specified team. The team-id on params will be used to filter and
  check writable permissons on team.

commands.name: restore-deleted-team-files
commands.docstring:
Removes the deletion mark from the specified files (and respective
  projects) on the specified team.

commands.name: create-font-variant
commands.docstring:
Upload a font variant. Font data must be provided as an `:uploads`
  map (keyed by mime-type, values are upload-session UUIDs from the
  chunked-upload API).

commands.name: download-font
commands.docstring: Download the font file. Returns a http redirect to the asset resource uri.

commands.name: download-font-family
commands.docstring:
Download the entire font family as a zip file. Returns the zip
  bytes on the body, without encoding it on transit or json.

commands.name: login-with-ldap
commands.docstring:
Performs the authentication using LDAP backend. Only works if LDAP
  is properly configured and enabled with `login-with-ldap` flag.

commands.name: duplicate-file
commands.docstring: Duplicate a single file in the same team.

commands.name: duplicate-project
commands.docstring: Duplicate an entire project with all the files

commands.name: move-files
commands.docstring: Move a set of files from one project to other.

commands.name: move-project
commands.docstring: Move projects between teams

commands.name: clone-template
commands.docstring: Clone into the specified project the template by its id.

commands.name: get-nitrate-activation-code-request
commands.docstring:
Returns a Base64-encoded JSON file requesting a Nitrate activation code.
  Payload includes nitrateId, publicKey, email and iat.

commands.name: check-nitrate-sso
commands.docstring:
Check if a user needs to login into the organization SSO.
  Accepts either team-id (to look up the organization via the team) or organization-id directly.
  Returns {:authorized true :reason :sso-satisfied} when SSO is not active or the
  session already holds a valid entry for the organization, and
  {:authorized true :reason :no-team-access} when the gate was skipped because the
  user cannot access the team; the reason lets the client tell a usable session
  apart from a plain permission failure.
  Returns {:authorized false :redirect-uri <url>} when SSO is active;
  the client must redirect there. The OIDC provider itself handles
  re-authentication transparently if the user already has an active SSO session.
  A nil :redirect-uri means SSO is required but the provider is not usable.

commands.name: get-owned-organizations-summary
commands.docstring:
List organizations owned by the current profile with team and member counts.
   Used by the delete-account modal to warn the user about cascading deletion.

commands.name: create-team-invitations
commands.docstring:
A rpc call that allows to send single or multiple invitations to join the team.

  Supports two parameter formats:
  1. emails (set) + role (single role for all emails)
  2. invitations (vector of {:email :role} maps for individual roles)

commands.name: create-team-access-request
commands.docstring: A rpc call that allow to request for an invitations to join the team.

commands.name: get-team-users
commands.docstring: Get team users by team-id or by file-id

commands.name: get-team-info
commands.docstring: Retrieve minimal team info by its ID.

commands.name: authenticate
commands.docstring: Authenticate the current user

commands.name: get-penpot-version
commands.docstring: Get the current Penpot version

commands.name: get-teams
commands.docstring: List teams for which current user is owner

commands.name: get-member-teams
commands.docstring: List all active teams where the current user is a member

commands.name: update-profile-theme
commands.docstring: Update the current user's theme

commands.name: update-profile-props
commands.docstring: Merge writable properties into the current user's profile

commands.name: upload-organization-logo
commands.docstring:
Store an organization logo in penpot storage and return its ID.
  Accepts an optional previous-id to mark the old logo for garbage
  collection when replacing an existing one.

commands.name: notify-team-change
commands.docstring: Notify to Penpot a team change from nitrate

commands.name: notify-user-added-to-organization
commands.docstring: Notify to Penpot that an user has joined an organization from nitrate

commands.name: get-managed-profiles
commands.docstring: List profiles that belong to teams for which current user is owner

commands.name: get-teams-summary
commands.docstring: Get summary information for a list of teams

commands.name: notify-organization-deletion
commands.docstring:
For a deleted organization, preserve organization teams and only prefix or delete
   imported Personal Projects before notifying connected users.

commands.name: notify-user-organizations-deletion
commands.docstring:
For a given user, find all owned organizations and apply the deleted-organization
   transfer rules to their imported Personal Projects teams.

commands.name: get-profile-by-email
commands.docstring: Get profile by email

commands.name: get-profile-by-id
commands.docstring: Get profile by email

commands.name: get-organization-member-team-counts
commands.docstring: Get the number of non-default teams each profile belongs to within a set of teams.

commands.name: invite-to-organization
commands.docstring: Invite to organization

commands.name: get-organization-invitations
commands.docstring: Get valid invitations for an organization, returning at most one invitation per email.

commands.name: delete-organization-invitations
commands.docstring: Delete all invitations for one email in an organization scope (organization + organization teams).

commands.name: delete-all-organization-invitations
commands.docstring:
Delete every pending invitation associated with an organization (organization-level + team-level).
   Called from Nitrate when an organization is about to be deleted, so users that click
   their invitation token hit the existing invalid-token landing page.

commands.name: remove-from-organization
commands.docstring: Remove an user from an organization

commands.name: get-remove-from-organization-summary
commands.docstring:
Get a summary of the teams that would be deleted, transferred, or exited
   if the user were removed from the organization

commands.name: send-renewal-email
commands.docstring: Send an Enterprise subscription renewal notice email to a user.

commands.name: exists-organization-team-invitations-for-non-members
commands.docstring: Return if there are any team invitations for emails that are not organization members.

commands.name: delete-organization-team-invitations-for-non-members
commands.docstring: Delete team invitations for emails that are not organization members.

commands.name: push-audit-events
commands.docstring:
Push audit events from nitrate (strictly for nitrate backend
  events)

commands.name: get-teams-detail
commands.docstring:
Get detailed information for all non-deleted teams in an organization,
   including owner info and project/file/member counts.

commands.name: check-organization-sso
commands.docstring:
Validate an organization SSO configuration by generating a login redirect URL.
  Nitrate calls this while configuring SSO to verify client credentials and OIDC
  discovery before saving the settings. The issuer URL is nitrate-supplied
  (customer-configured), so it is checked against the SSRF blocklist before
  any outbound request is attempted.

commands.name: notify-organization-sso-change
commands.docstring: Nitrate notifies that an organization sso values have changed

commands.name: bulk-create-profiles
commands.docstring:
Create multiple already-active profiles that share a single password. The
   created users skip email verification and onboarding. Emails that already
   belong to an existing profile are skipped. Intended for the Nitrate admin
   bulk-creation screen; access is gated by the shared key and, in Nitrate, an
   email allow-list. Requires the `admin-console-bulk-create-profiles` flag, disabled
   by default so it is only available on test environments.

commands.name: get-air-gapped
commands.docstring: Returns whether this Penpot instance runs in air-gapped mode.
